name: General Insurance Corporation of India
publicShareholdingNotes: GIC was listed on 25.10.2017 with 14.22% held by Public. As per proviso to Rule 19A (1) of SCR Rules, 1957 (amendment dt. 3.8.2018) , co. with public holding below 25%, increase it to atleast 25%, within 2 yr. Subsequently, the Corporation is in receipt of letter dt. 19.7.2024 from MOF stating that CG in exercise of powers granted under Rule 19A(6) has granted exemption to every listed public sector company which has public shareholding below 25%, to increase it to atleast 25% upto 1.8.2026.
